name: GOV extended: RoleCapabilityUpdated (Solmate MultiRolesAuthority)
description: Solmate MultiRolesAuthority: RoleCapabilityUpdated(uint8,bytes4,bool) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity high. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
